description: Unit tests for the Huffman transcoder used in HTTP/2 HPACK header compression, including round-trip tests for encoding and decoding of strings with various characters.

classes.name: HpackHuffmanTranscoderTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for Huffman transcoder tests, providing methods for encoding, decoding, and validation.

classes.name: HpackHuffmanTranscoderAdjacentCharTest
classes.description: Parameterized test class for testing adjacent character round-trip encoding/decoding.

classes.name: HpackHuffmanTranscoderRepeatedCharTest
classes.description: Parameterized test class for testing repeated character encoding/decoding.

methods.name: GenAsciiNonControlSet
methods.description: Generates a string of ASCII characters excluding control characters.

methods.name: StartDecoding
methods.description: Initializes decoding process, resets counters and decoder state.

methods.name: ResumeDecoding
methods.description: Continues decoding from buffer, updates counters, and checks for completion or errors.

methods.name: TranscodeAndValidateSeveralWays
methods.description: Encodes a string with Huffman, then decodes and validates the round-trip correctness.

methods.name: RandomAsciiNonControlString
methods.description: Generates a random string of ASCII non-control characters.

methods.name: RandomBytes
methods.description: Generates a random string of bytes.

methods.name: MakeString
methods.description: Creates a string of repeated characters for testing.
